feats.name: Alert
feats.tagline: You always act first in ambushes. Enemies can never get the drop on you.
feats.detail: You can't be surprised while conscious, and you gain a +5 bonus to initiative.

feats.name: Tough
feats.tagline: Simply harder to kill. Your health globe is noticeably larger.
feats.detail: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 per level (+2 HP now, more as you grow).

feats.name: Savage Attacker
feats.tagline: Your melee hits are more consistently devastating. Less whiffing, more crunching.
feats.detail: Once per turn, reroll melee weapon damage and use the higher result.
